title: Juice N Power Kiwi Honeydew & Mint Nic Salt E-Liquid 5mg
description: Experience a true flavour sensation with a honeydew and berry medley topped off with a refreshing layer of tangy kiwi and cool mint. A mouth-watering taste of summer fruits. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
